description: Use this skill when writing or reviewing Apex change event triggers: trigger syntax on ChangeEvent objects, reading ChangeEventHeader fields (changeType, changedFields, recordIds, commitUser), handling CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE/UNDELETE and GAP events in Apex, and configuring entity tracking. NOT for platform events published by application code (use apex/platform-events-apex). NOT for external CDC subscribers via CometD or Pub/Sub API (use integration/change-data-capture-integration). Keywords: AccountChangeEvent, MyObject__ChangeEvent, transactionKey, sequenceNumber, nulledFields, diffFields, changeOrigin, GAP_OVERFLOW, PlatformEventChannelMember, enrichedFields, PlatformEventSubscriberConfig, Test.enableChangeDataCapture, idempotent change event subscriber.
inputs: Object(s) to track via CDC (standard or custom)
Business logic that must react to CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, or UNDELETE
Whether only specific field changes should trigger action (field-level filtering)
Whether downstream logic can tolerate async execution (it must — CDC triggers always run async)
name: change-data-capture-apex
official_sources: **Apex Reference Guide — `EventBus.ChangeEventHeader` class and properties** (`apexrefguide` L157167–157447) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/apex_ref_guide.pdf — the twelve header properties and their exact types and semantics: the `changeType` enumeration including `SNAPSHOT` and `GAP_OVERFLOW` (L157286–157304), `changedFields` including `LastModifiedDate` (L157231–157232), `nulledFields` as the way to tell null-set from unchanged (L157381–157385), `diffFields` for large text (L157353–157358), the `recordIds` merge rule and the `001*` wildcard (L157393–157417), `commitNumber`'s non-uniqueness across database instances (L157306–157310), `sequenceNumber` and the lead-conversion example (L157420–157436), `transactionKey` (L157438–157441), and the `changeOrigin` format and purpose (L157245–157275).

**Apex Reference Guide — `Test.enableChangeDataCapture()`** (`apexrefguide` L240419–240437) — same PDF — the test-side contract: call it at the beginning of the test before DML and before `Test.getEventBus().deliver()`, and it fires triggers regardless of the entities selected in Setup, so a green test proves nothing about org enablement.

**Apex Developer Guide — Execution Governors and Limits** (`apexdev` L19540–19582) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf — 100/200 SOQL, 150 DML, **6 MB synchronous / 12 MB asynchronous heap** (L19577), 10,000/60,000 ms CPU, and `System.enqueueJob` at 50 synchronous but **1** asynchronous (L19571) — the number that caps "dispatch to a Queueable" advice.

**Apex Developer Guide — Static Apex Limits footnote 2** (`apexdev` L19862) — same PDF — "The Apex trigger batch size for platform events and Change Data Capture events is 2,000." This is the only in-corpus statement of the CDC trigger batch size.

**Apex Developer Guide — Enforcing Object and Field Permissions, and Versioned Behavior Changes** (`apexdev` L11921–11922, L11744–11748, L18734–18740) — same PDF — "Automated Process users can't perform Object and FLS checks in custom code unless appropriate permission sets are explicitly applied to those users", and the API 67.0 switch to user context by default with `with sharing` as the unstated default. Together these are the security-context gotcha for every CDC subscriber.

**Apex Developer Guide — External Change Data Capture Packaging and Testing** (`apexdev` L29624–29685) — same PDF — the only in-corpus sample of a change event trigger (`on Products__ChangeEvent (after insert)`), of constructing an `EventBus.ChangeEventHeader` in a test, and of `event.ChangeEventHeader.getChangeType()`. It is an **External** CDC sample, which is why this package marks the constructed-event test pattern UNVERIFIED for platform CDC.

**Apex Developer Guide — callouts from triggers** (`apexdev` L14900) — same PDF — "Callouts must be made asynchronously from a trigger so that the trigger process isn't blocked while waiting for the external service", the grounding for the Queueable / `@future(callout=true)` hop.

**Metadata API Developer Guide — `PlatformEventChannelMember` and `PlatformEventChannel`** (`api_meta` L95840–96200) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf — enabling CDC per object as deployable metadata on the `ChangeEvents` standard channel (L96098–96108), `enrichedFields` (L96047–96050), `filterExpression` (L96057–96066), the `ChannelName_EventName` full-name format and the double-underscore collapse (L96105–96108, L96153–96157), and that the standard channel itself cannot be deployed or retrieved (L95921).

**Metadata API Developer Guide — `PlatformEventSubscriberConfig`** (`api_meta` L96385–96496) — same PDF — `batchSize` 1–2,000 with 2,000 the default and the explicit "we don't recommend setting the batch size to 1" (L96416–96424), and the `user` field's four documented consequences including that the default Automated Process entity cannot send email (L96453–96465).

**Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform — `StandardObjectNameChangeEvent`** (`object_reference` L5119–5210) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf — the change event naming rule (L5148–5156), that a change event "isn't a Salesforce object — it doesn't support CRUD operations or queries" (L5122–5123), the field exclusions: `IsDeleted`, `SystemModStamp`, formula and derived fields, **with roll-up summary fields included** (L5157–5163), that custom-setting change events "aren't supported in Apex triggers" (L5140–5143), and the worked JSON event message reproduced in `references/examples.md` Example 3 (L5178–5203).

**Salesforce App Limits Cheat Sheet** (`salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet` L417, L1249–1251) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.pdf — repeats the 2,000 trigger batch size, and — importantly for what this package does *not* claim — points at "Change Data Capture Allocations" without reproducing the entity limit, retention window or daily delivery allocation. Every number in that family is marked UNVERIFIED here.

**Change Data Capture Developer Guide** — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.change_data_capture.meta/change_data_capture/cdc_intro.htm — cited as the source for the claims this package marks UNVERIFIED: async delivery timing, the synchronous-limits classification of change event triggers, gap event causes and payload shape, the 5-entity allocation and 72-hour retention, `getRecordIds()` as a method, and enriched-field behaviour in Apex. Not fetchable from this environment; every claim resting on it carries a marker beside it.
**Salesforce Well-Architected Overview** — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html — reliability and performance framing for the pillars section above.
outputs: Apex CDC trigger with correct syntax and header field access
Idempotency key and dedupe store keyed on transactionKey + sequenceNumber
PlatformEventChannelMember XML that enables CDC for the object as deployable metadata
GAP event detection and recovery logic
PlatformEventSubscriberConfig guidance when running user or batch size override is needed
